newsitem.title: ESTONIA: PAKTERMINAL 97 Q1 TURNOVER 150 MLN EEK - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: PAKTERMINAL 97 Q1 TURNOVER 150 MLN EEK - REPORT.

text.p: Pakterminal, the largest oil trans-shipping company in Estonia, said had first quarter 1997 turnover of 150 million kroons versus 75 million kroons for the first quarter of 1996, newspaper Aripaev said on Tuesday.
The company made a profit of over 200 million kroons in 1996, the business newspaper added.

Paterminal's current capacity is 135,000 cubic meters and the company plans to increase its capacity by 36,000 cubic metres during 1997, chairman of the board, Aadu Luukas, was quoted by the newspaper as saying.
The new tanks will not significantly increase Pakterminal's capacity but will improve its cumstomer service because it can operate with a small reserve, Lukkus told Aripaev.
